a11y: The title is plain text (not a heading by default) so it doesn't break the page outline. Pass as="h2" or h3 when it heads a section.
The icon is decorative and hidden from screen readers.
After a search, put the result count or this message in a live region so screen-reader users hear that nothing was found.
